fixes.explanation: You got it, baker. Verse 8 says, "So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the area of Mount Seir." (Genesis 36:8) Later the passage lists the sons of Seir the Horite, "…who were living in the land…" (Genesis 36:20) So Seir is a name worth remembering. Esau shows up with all his stuff, and I think he needed every bit of that room.

Mount Sinai matters a lot later in the Bible. The LORD comes down on it in Exodus 19:18-20, and He gives the Ten Commandments in Exodus 20:1-17. But it's not where Esau settled. Verse 8 says, "So Esau (that is, Edom) settled in the area of Mount Seir." (Genesis 36:8) Sinai and Seir both start with S, and that's about as far as the match goes.
